consumption.method: Git dependency pinned by an exact revision from the local isolated clone. Never a floating branch, never an uncommitted path, no publication and no shared remote.
localReproduction: 1. Keep the isolated engine clone at C:/Users/Thomas/Desktop/RapidRAW-engine on branch feature/lap-engine-extraction (no publication, no remote creation; C:/Users/Thomas/Desktop/RapidRAW stays reference-only).

2. To rebuild or extend the engine locally: git -C C:/Users/Thomas/Desktop/RapidRAW-engine checkout e1035c38aa1150ac350faa3661f26144a922ea91, then apply the toolchain PATH prepend and build with cargo as usual. Engine changes require a new pinned revision plus a new lock entry here before any host adopts them.

3. In the consumer crate (Lap src-tauri in a later slice), reference rapidraw-develop (and rapidraw-edit-model if needed directly) with the cargoDependency above; Cargo records the exact rev in the consumer Cargo.lock, making consumption reproducible without network services, credentials, or model downloads.

4. Windows MAX_PATH caution: rawler's git checkout contains deeply nested testdata paths. A fresh dependency cache must live under a short path (the verification below used C:/Users/Thomas/.cg1, 20 characters, deleted afterwards); deeper CARGO_HOME roots fail cargo fetch with 'path too long'.
